findings.text: The requirements ask for shots of today and 2026-10-20 at 1200 and 1920 saved in this folder's `shots/`, but `day-approve/shots/` does not exist in the main tree or in the qf-2 worktree. `proof.mjs` writes there, so the run may have failed or the files were never committed; without them the "no merge list on the past day" and "approved shows on the session page" claims are unproven.

`AIDay.js:84-90` (diff lines) matches the snapshot by `x.folder === s.rel` in the day index, while the session page finds it by id (`AISessionDetail.js:58`). That is reasonable, but the reverse check (approve on the session page, day page shows approved) rests on `Approvals` keying by `snap.id` in the same day.jsonl, and only the shots would prove it.

`AIDay.approve` calls `snap.day.replaceAll(...)` with no fallback, while `find_snaps` and `approval()` tolerate a missing `snap.day` (`?? day`, `?? ""`). A snapshot without `day` would show a button that throws on press; use the same fallback in all three places.
`proof.mjs` hardcodes port 53825, but the brief names the worktree server at 58948. Harmless, but the file will not run as-is.

Requirements 1 (button, approved state, no-snapshot line, reuse of `Approvals`), 2 (`ReadyToMerge` only when `this.day === AIDay.today()`, placed above the list) and 3 (both readme lines) are all met in the diff. Only AIDay files and the one readme line changed. The empty-list one-liner is left to `ReadyToMerge` itself; I did not check that it says so.

answer.reply: noted: the shots exist, committed on worktree/qf-3 (9c26100c6); Servex placed the builder in qf-3, not the qf-2 the brief named, so the reviewer looked in the wrong tree. They arrive with the merge.

noted: both pages find the snapshot the same way. The session page's SessionTree.load(day, folder) and the day page each take the folder's day index.json and match snapshots by folder; both then use Approvals.of_day(snap.day).of(snap.id). Proven by reading the code, not by a run (the worktree lacks the session's generated records).
fixed: 061a1d39f sets snap.day once from the folder's day, so the stream, the lookup and the write agree.
noted: 53825 is qf-3's port, the right one.
noted: ReadyToMerge.paint says "Nothing waiting to merge." for an empty list (read from the code).

declined: nothing to fix. The four shots and approved-1200.png are committed on worktree/qf-3 (9c26100c6), the tree Servex gave the builder; the reviewer read the main tree and qf-2. They land with the merge.
